welcome.title: Welcome to Meshtastic
welcome.body: Send text messages over long-range LoRa radios, with no cell service or internet. This web client connects to your radio straight from the browser.
welcome.offGridBody: Chat on channels or directly with any node.
welcome.encryptedBody: Channels share a key; direct messages use public keys.
welcome.meshBody: Every node your radio hears, on a list and a map.

connect.title: Connect your radio
connect.body: Pick how your radio is connected. You can add more radios later from the device menu.
connect.unsupported: This browser can't use Bluetooth or USB radios. Open this page in Chrome, Edge or Opera on desktop, or connect over Wi-Fi below.
connect.unsupportedInsecure: Bluetooth and USB only work on secure pages. Open this site over HTTPS, or connect over Wi-Fi below.
connect.bluetoothBody: Pair wirelessly. Needs Chrome, Edge or Opera.
connect.serialBody: Plug in with a data cable. Chrome or Edge on desktop.
connect.httpBody: For a radio on your network. Enter its address.
connect.unavailableBluetooth: {{browser}} doesn't support Web Bluetooth, which Bluetooth connections need.
connect.unavailableSerial: {{browser}} doesn't support Web Serial, which USB connections need.
connect.unavailableBluetoothIos: Browsers on iPhone and iPad don't support Web Bluetooth, which Bluetooth connections need.
connect.unavailableSerialIos: Browsers on iPhone and iPad don't support Web Serial, which USB connections need.
connect.unavailableInsecure: Needs a secure page. Open this site over HTTPS.
connect.addressInvalid: Enter an IP address or host name, like 192.168.1.50 or meshtastic.local.
connect.useHttps: Use HTTPS (only if your radio is set up for it)
connect.httpsRequired: This page is served over HTTPS, so this browser can only reach the radio over HTTPS.

pairing.title: Pick your radio
pairing.bodyBluetooth: Your browser is showing a list of nearby radios. Choose yours, then select Pair.
pairing.bodySerial: Your browser is showing a list of USB devices. Choose your radio, then select Connect.
pairing.closed: The list was closed before a radio was chosen.
pairing.illustrationNote: Illustration of the browser's own picker. Its look depends on the browser.
pairing.notListed: My radio isn't in the list
pairing.pickerTitleSerial: This site wants to connect to a serial port

error.title: Couldn't connect to your radio
error.intro: A few things usually fix it:
error.powerOn: Make sure the radio is on and close to this computer.
error.phoneApp: Disconnect it from the phone app. A radio accepts one Bluetooth connection at a time.
error.dataCable: For USB, use a data cable. Some cables only charge.
error.otherTab: Close other tabs or apps that use the radio's USB port.
error.sameNetwork: Make sure this computer is on the same network as the radio.
error.address: Check the address. The radio shows it on its screen or in the phone app.
error.https: If HTTPS is on, the radio needs it turned on too.
error.reboot: Still stuck? Reboot the radio and try again.
error.dropped: The radio disconnected before setup finished.
error.timeout: The radio didn't answer within 30 seconds.

sync.title: Connected to {{name}}
sync.body: Getting your radio's settings and the nodes it has heard. This takes a few seconds.

profile.title: Make it yours
profile.body: This is how other people on the mesh will see you.
profile.shortNameHelp: Up to 4 bytes: 4 letters, or one emoji
profile.longNameTooLong: Too long: the radio keeps up to 24 bytes.
profile.shortNameTooLong: Too long: the radio keeps up to 4 bytes.
profile.regionUnset: Your radio won't transmit until a region is set. Choose the one for where you are, so you stay within local radio rules.
profile.regionRestart: Changing the region restarts the radio.
profile.regionRequired: Choose a region. Your radio doesn't transmit without one.
profile.loraNotLoaded: The radio's LoRa settings haven't loaded yet. Wait a moment and try again.
profile.savedRestarting: Profile saved. Your radio is restarting with the new region; this takes a few seconds.

channel.title: Join your group's channel
channel.body: You're on the default public channel. If a local group shared a channel link with you, add it now. You can always do this later.
channel.bodyCustom: If a local group shared a channel link with you, add it now. You can always do this later.
channel.linkEmpty: Paste a channel link to add it.
channel.linkInvalid: This isn't a Meshtastic channel link.
channel.skipped_one: {{count}} channel is already on your radio or has no free slot, so it won't be added.
channel.skipped_other: {{count}} channels are already on your radio or have no free slot, so they won't be added.
channel.nothingToAdd: Every channel in this link is already on your radio.
channel.reconnecting: Waiting for the radio to finish restarting…
channel.loraNotLoaded: The radio's LoRa settings haven't loaded yet. Wait a moment and try again.
channel.savedRestarting: Channels saved. Your radio is restarting with the link's radio settings.
channel.confirmRegion: This also changes your region from {{from}} to {{to}}, including the one you just chose.
channel.confirmRestart: Your current channels are removed and the radio restarts to apply the link's radio settings.

done.title: You're on the mesh
done.body: {{name}} is connected. Here's where to find things.
done.bodySkipped: Connect a radio any time from the device menu. Here's where to find things.
done.messagesBody: Channels and direct messages, with replies and reactions.
done.nodesBody: Every radio you have heard, with hops and signal.
done.commandBody: Jump to any chat, node or setting.

caption.welcome: Each radio relays messages for the others, so a message can hop across the mesh to reach people far beyond one radio's range.
caption.connect: Your browser talks to your radio; your radio talks to the mesh. Nothing goes through a server.
caption.connectUnsupported: Bluetooth and USB connections rely on browser features that only some browsers support. Wi-Fi works everywhere.
caption.connectHttp: Radios with Wi-Fi can join your network and serve this client directly.
caption.pairingError: No connection yet. Your radio is still listening to the mesh on its own.
caption.sync: Your radio remembers every node it has heard, even while this page was closed.
caption.profile: Your short name appears on avatars and the map, so pick something people will recognise.
caption.channel: Channels share a key. Only radios with the same channel can read its messages.
caption.done: A message can reach you through several hops across other people's radios.
caption.pairingSerial: Waiting for you to choose a port…
